items.text: Sulemani yeenjisia lisanduku muhekalu

Mana Sulemani yakhung'aasia abakofu baIsiraeli, nabeemilisi bosi betsimbia, abakhulundu bebilibwa biabaana baIsiraeli, ewomuruchi Sulemani eYerusalemu, khulwa okhutikulusia lisanduku lieindakano yOMWAMI okhurula mwitookho liaDaudi, nilio Sayuni.
Abandu bosi baIsiraeli nibakhung'aana ewomuruchi Sulemani khwisabo, mumwesi kwaEtsanimu, nikwo omwesi kwomusaafu.
Abakofu bosi baIsiraeli nibeetsa abakuhani nabo nibachinga lisanduku.
Nibatikulusia lisanduku liOMWAMI, neliheema liokhwakaana, nebimanulwa ebitakatifu biosi ebiali nibili mwiheema; ebio biosi abakuhani nabaLawi babileera.

Naye omuruchi Sulemani, nomukhung'aano kwosi kwaIsiraeli, okwali nikukhung'aaniile ewuwe, bali ninaye imbeli welisanduku nibamalanga emisango chiamakondi netsing'ombe, echirachelekha kata okhubalikha obunji bwachio ta.
Mana abakuhani nibeenjisia lisanduku lieindakano yOMWAMI habundu walio mushisika tsana shiomukari, habundu ahashila obutakatifu, hasi wetsimbaha tsiabakerubi.
Okhuba abakerubi babambula tsimbaha tsiabwe ikulu wahabundu welisanduku, abakerubi nibafuunikha lisanduku netsinyanzo tsialio hekulu bwene

Natsio tsinyanzo tsana tsiali tsirambi muno, emirwe chiatsio nichiloleshela abali habundu ahatakatifu imbeli weshisika shiahakari, ne shitsialolekha elwanyi ta; ne tsishiliyo tsirio okhuula olwa leelo.
Mwisanduku shimwalimwo eshindu ta, habula orubaho rwamachina rubili orwa Musa yareelamwo eHorebu, ewa OMWAMI yalakana nabaana baIsiraeli indakano, olwa bali nibarulile mushialo shiaMisiri.
Ne olwa abakuhani bali nibarulile habundu ahatakatifu, lileesi tsana lieetsula munzu yOMWAMI,
okhuula olwa abakuhani bakhaywa okhusinjila okhukhalabana, khulwa lileesi; okhuba oluyali lwOMWAMI Iweetsula munzu yOMWAMI tu.
Obwahulwi bweihekalu
Mana omuruchi nashiukhana, nasabila omukhung'aano kwosi kwaIsiraeli ikhabi, abomukhung'aano kwosi kwaIsiraeli nibasinjiile.
Nasunga mbu OMWAMI, Nyasaye waIsiraeli, yeetsoomibwe, owasungana naDaudi papa nomunwa, mana nakoosia nomukhonokwe, ar

Okhurula khunyanga eya ndarusia abandu banje Isiraeli muMisiri, shindalobola litaala liosi eliomumbia tsiosi tsiaIsiraeli, okhuumbashilayo inzu, mbu eliira lianje libeetsenjeyo ta; habula ndalobola Daudi aruche abandu banje Isiraeli.
Ne Daudi papa yali napaaranga mumwoyokwe mbu yakhoombashila eliira liOMWAMI, Nyasaye waIsiraeli, inzu.
Nebutswa OMWAMI yasunjila Daudi papa mbu Olwa obeele nopaaranga mumwoyokwo okhuumbashila eliira lianje inzu, kabeele amalayi aka opaarilenje orio mumwoyo;
nebutswa iwe shiloombakha inzu tsana ta; habula omwanawo owa oleebula, niye ouliumbashila eliira lianje inzu.

Ne bulaano OMWAMI wusiye likhuwa elo elia yaboola; okhuba isie ndabuushile mushilenje shiaDaudi papa, nindiikhaale khushifumbi shioburuchi shiaIsiraeli, shinga OMWAMI olwa yasuubisia; ne enyumbashiile eliira liOMWAMI, Nyasaye waIsiraeli, inzu.
Khandi mubwenomwo engasiye habundu welisanduku elilimwo indakano yOMWAMI, eya yalakana nabakuuka, olwa yabarusia mushialo shiaMisiri.
Mana Sulemani nasinjila imbeli weshimalilo shiOMWAMI, imbeli womukhung'aano kwosi kwaIsiraeli, nakalishila likulu amakhono.

Naboola mbu E OMWAMI, Nyasaye waIsiraeli, abulaho Nyasaye undi oufwanana ninawe, ikulu mwikulu kata khushialo hasi, ta; iwe owusinjia indakanoyo nobuheeli oburalilu khubasumbabo abachendanga imbeliwo nomwoyo kwosi;
iwe owusiliye omusumbawo Daudi papa ako aka wamusuubisia; toto, wakasunga nomunwa, ne leelo luno okoosiye nomukhonokwo.

Kho bulaano, OMWAMI, Nyasaye waIsiraeli, wusilie omusumbawo Daudi papa akeenako aka wamusuubisia, mbu Shiolachweyakhwo okhuba nomundu imbeli wanje okhwikhala khushifumbi shioburuchi shiaIsiraeli ta, abaanabo nibaba nibeerechelesia khunjila tsiabwe, okhuchenda imbeli wanje shinga iwe olwa wachendilenje imbeli wanje.
Kho bulaano, e Nyasaye waIsiraeli, ekhusaaya mbu likhuwalio limanyishe nilili eliatoto, elia wasunjila omusumbawo Daudi papa.
Ne Nyasaye alamenya mushialo toto? Mbula, likulu kata likulu elili hekulu mwikulu shilikhuhela ta; kho inzu yino eya enyumbashile yakhakhuhela yirie!
Nebutswa witsulile isaala yanje, isie omusumbawo, nokhusaaya khwanje, e OMWAMI Nyasaye wanje, nohulila okhuhaaba khwanje neisaala eya isie omusumbawo esaaya imbeliwo leelo;

mbu tsimonitsio tsitimbushilenje inzu yino eshilo neshiteere, okhuhenganga habundu aha wasungakhwo mbu Eliira lianje lilabeetsangaho, okhuhulila isaala eya omusumbawo alasaayanga nahenjile habundu hano.
Oreche amarwi khukhusaaya khwanje, isie omusumbawo, nokhwabandubo Isiraeli, olwa balasaaya nibahenjile habundu hano; ne ewa oli mwikulu, mushimenyoshio, ohulile; ne olwa oba nohulila, okhuleshele.
Omundu naba niyoonoonela owashie, nibamurakhwo eshiitsubo nibamwitsubia; naye niyeetsa, niyeetsuba imbeli weshimaliloshio munzu yino;

mana ewa oli mwikulu, ohulile, nokhola, noyaasia abasumbabo, nomukhalachila eshiina ouli omubii, nomutuukha ebiimabie khumurwekwe; nololosia obulunjishi bwomulunjishi, nomukalusia akakhoyeele obulunjishibwe.
Olwa abandubo Isiraeli baba nibahulwa imbeli wabasuku, shichila bakhwonooneele; nibaba nibakhushiukhanila, nibeeyama eliiralio, nibakhusaba nokhusaaya munzu yino;
mana ewa oli mwikulu, ohulile, noleshela abandubo Isiraeli obwonooni bwabwe, nobachelesia mushialo eshia waheelesia abakuuka babwe.
Olwa likulu liba niliikaale, ifula niyibulaho, shichila bakhwonooneele; nibaba nibasaaya nibahenjile habundu hano, nibeeyama eliiralio, nibashiukhana okhulekha obwonooni bwabwe, olwa oba nobasandiye;

mana ewa oli mwikulu, ohulile, noleshela abasumbabo obwonooni bwabwe, obwabandubo Isiraeli, olwa obeebaalila injila indayi eya bakhoyile okhuchendelamwo; noleera ifula khushialoshio, eshia waheelesia abandubo shibe obulaame.

Niyiba niyakhabamwo inzala mushialo, niyakhabamwo oluumbe, nikhwakhabamwo emimela okhukwa amatere, kata ebikhwalo, kata tsisiche, kata tsikhungu; abasuku nibaba nibakhabeekalila mumataala kabwe; amanyasio kosi kosi, kata obulwale bwosi bwosi obubaho;

isaala yosi yosi nokhusaaya khwosi khwosi okhusaaywa nomundu yesi, kata nabandubo bosi Isiraeli, nibamanyile buli mundu amanyasio akali mumwoyo kukwe omwene, buli mundu nakalishila inzu yino amakhono;

mana ewa oli mwikulu, mushimenyoshio, ohulile, nobaleshela, nokhola, nobakalusia buli mundu ebiimabie shinga olwa bili, olwa omanyanga akomwoyokwe; okhuba niwe, iwe wenyene, oumanyanga emioyo chiabaana bosi babandu;
mbu bakhuriitsenje tsindaalo tsiosi, olwa balamenyanga mushialo eshia waheelesia abakuuka.
Kata omusuku yesi, ourali owokhubandubo Isiraeli, olwa alaba narulile mushialo shiehale khulwa eliiralio;
okhuba balahulila akeliiralio likhongo, nakomukhonokwo kwamaani, nakomukhonokwo okunyiililwe okhuhonia; kho olwa aleetsa nasaaya nahenjile khunzu yino;

ewa oli mwikulu, mushimenyoshio, ohulile, nokhola kosi aka omusuku tsana aba nakhuhaabilila; mbu abetsimbia tsiosi etsiomushialo bamanye eliiralio, nibakhuria, shinga abandubo Isiraeli olwa bakhola; khandi mbu bamanye shinga inzu yino eya enyumbaashe olwa yikulishilwa khuliiralio.
Abandubo nibaba nibarula okhuseera abasuku babwe, khunjila yosi yosi eya olabarumilakhwo, nibasaaya OMWAMI nibahenjile khwitookho elia waloboole, khandi khunzu eya enyumbashiile eliiralio;
mana ewa oli mwikulu ohulile isaala yabwe nokhusaaya khwabwe, noterela eshifune shiabwe.
Nibaba nibakhwonoonela-okhuba abulaho ouroonoonakhwo tanawe nobatiililwa oburima, nobahaanila abasuku, nabo nibabahamba imbambe nibabayila mushialo shiabasuku, kata eshiehale kata eshiahambi;

ne nibaba nibeetsulila mushialo tsana ewa bayilwa mumbambe, nibeekalukhasia nibakhusaaya ebweneyo mushialo shiabo ababayila mumbambe, nibasunga mbu Khwayoonoonile, nikhukhola akobukhayikhanu; khwakholile obubii;

nibaba nibakhukalushila nomwoyo kwosi neshiimo shiosi mushialo tsana shiabasuku babwe, ababayila mumbamba, nibakhusaaya nibahenjile eshialo shiabwe eshia waheelesia abakuuka babwe, nelitookho elia walobola, neinzu eya enyumbashiile eliiralio;
mana ewa oli mwikulu, mushimenyoshio, ohulile isaala yabwe nokhusaaya khwabwe, noterela eshifune shiabwe;
noleshela abandubo abakhwonooneele, nobukhayi bwabwe bwosi obwa bakhukhayile; nobabeela tsimbabasi imbeli wabo ababayila mumbambe, mbu bababeele tsimbabasi.
Okhuba nabandubo, nobulaamebwo, aba warusia muMisiri, okhurula mumulilo omululumu okufwana shinga okurulanga eshibia;
mbu tsimonitsio tsitimbushile okhusaaya khwomusumbawo, nokhusaaya khwabandubo Isiraeli, okhubahulila buli olwa bakhuhaabila lwosi.
Okhuba wabaahukhasia okhurula mumbia tsiosi etsili mushialo, mbu babe obulaamebwo, shinga olwa waboola mumunwa kwaMusa omusumbawo, olwa warusia abakuuka muMisiri e OMWAMI Nyasaye.
Mana olwa Sulemani yali namalile isaalaye yino namasaayoke khuMWAMI, yabuukha ewa yali imbeli weshimalilo shiOMWAMI, ewa yali nasikaame amasikamo nakalishiile likulu amakhono.
Nasinjila, nasabila omukhung'aano kwosi kwaIsiraeli ikhabi nomwoyo omukhongo; ari

OMWAMI yeetsoomibwe, owahulusiiye abandube Isiraeli, kosi aka yasuubisia shinga olwa kali; kata khubusuubisiibwe obulayi bwosi, obwa yakhusuubisia mumunwa kwaMusa omusumbawe, shiliachweyekha likhuwa kata elala ta.
OMWAMI Nyasaye weefwe abeetsenjeho nineefwe, shinga olwa yalinji nabakuuka; arakhulekha kata okhukhwibala ta;
yeenamie emioyo chieefwe khuye omwene, mbu khuchendenje munjilatsie tsiosi, nikhulinda amalakoke, naka alachilisia, nakobukhalachibwe, ebia yalaka abakuuka.

Nako amakhuwa kanje kano, aka esaayile imbeli w, kabeetsenje ahambi khuMWAMI Nyasaye weefwe eshiteere neshilo mbu aterele eshifune shiomusumbawe, neshifune shiabandube Isiraeli, obuha bwabuli nyanga shinga olwa buli;
mbu abetsimbia tsiosi tsiomushialo bamanye mbu OMWAMI niye Nyasaye; abulaho oundi.
Kho emioyo chieenywe chibe habwene imbeli wOMWAMI Nyasaye weefwe, okhuchenda muka alachilisia, nokhulinda amalakoke, shinga olwa muli leelo.
Mana omuruchi, naIsiraeli yosi halala ninaye, nibamalila OMWAMI emisango.

Sulemani yahaana khulwa emisango chiokhwishia echia yamalila OMWAMI, tsing'ombe ebikhumila amakhumi kabili nabibili, namakondi ebikhumila eshikhumi namakhumi kabili. Nilwo olwa omuruchi nabaana baIsiraeli bosi baahula inzu yOMWAMI.

Khunyanga yeneyo, omuruchi yaahula eshitonye shiahakari shiolwanyi olwali imbeli weinzu yOMWAMI; okhuba yamalilayo omusango omusambe, nomusango kweimele, namasinya kemisango chiokhwishia; shichila eshimalilo shiomukasa eshiali imbeli wOMWAMI shiali eshitiiti eshirahela okhureebwakhwo omusango omusambe nomusango kweimele namasinya kemisango chiokhwishia ta.

Kho Sulemani yakhola lisabo mundaalo etsio, naIsiraeli yosi halala ninaye, omukhung'aano omukhongo, okhurula khubwinjililo bwaHamatsi okhuula khumuchela kwaMisiri, imbeli wOMWAMI Nyasaye weefwe, tsindaalo musaafu.

Khunyanga yomunaane yaseebula abandu, nabo nibasabila omuruchi ikhabi, nibatsia ebunango nokhwikhoya, nibasangaalile mumioyo khulwa amalayi kosi aka OMWAMI yali nakholeele Daudi omusumbawe, nende Isiraeli abandube.
